name: omp-fusion
description: Fusion — run a hard question through an independent parallel model proposer wave, then an aggregator synthesizes. An OMP skill + slash commands (installs on vanilla pi too; parallel fan-out is OMP-native). Also ships /ultrafusion: N proposers -> M critics -> aggregator planning pipeline, plus omp-fusion/fusion-fast and fusion-samp fast-path variants.
author: Jordan Strauss

omp.description: Independent parallel model proposers then aggregator synthesis, plus an /ultrafusion planning pipeline (proposers then critics then aggregator). Ships the fusion skill + /fusion[-solo|-pair|-trio] commands and the ultrafusion skill + /ultrafusion command. Uses the bundled task agent in plugin mode, so no custom-agent install is required. Configure via modelRoles: aggregator (required, no fallback) and proposer_N are canonical and shared by all four pipelines; critic_N is Ultrafusion's own extra wave. Also registers an omp-fusion provider with four models: omp-fusion/fusion (proposers->aggregator), fusion-fast (majority-quorum proposers->aggregator), fusion-samp (random-sampled proposers->aggregator), and ultrafusion (proposers->critics->aggregator).
